title: AMA press release: 2025 Prior Authorization Physician Survey (insurer pledge skepticism)

history.reason: Source read directly on access date; findings transcribed from the document.

source_type: Press release summarizing the 2025 AMA Prior Authorization Physician Survey
reliability: Primary announcement of AMA's own survey of 1,000 practicing physicians; AMA is an interested party advocating PA reform. The linked survey PDF was not fetched or examined.
findings: AMA surveyed 1,000 practicing physicians (2025 AMA Prior Authorization Physician Survey).
Physicians complete an average of 40 PA requests per week; 32% report requests are often or always denied.
PA consumes an average of 13 hours of physician and staff time per week; 40% employ staff dedicated exclusively to PA.
74% report denials have increased over the past five years.
Only 33% believe the June 2025 insurer pledge will make a meaningful difference.
limitations: Publication date not confirmed: the page text refers to the June 2025 pledge as "last summer"; a date string on the page could not be confirmed as the release date, so published is left unknown.
Survey instrument, sampling method and practice-size breakdown not examined.
